title: When the Letter Sings
author: Marguerite Vasquez
blurb: Paloma Underhill, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
